facts.status_note: Removed in 1965 according to the register; firelookout.com says gone in 1969

notes_for_editor: Build year 1932 agrees across the register, firelookout.com and Rex's page. Removal year conflicts: register 1965 (matches its photo caption span 1932-1965) vs firelookout.com 'Gone 1969'; Rex's page says only 'Removed'. Structure type conflicts: register calls it a wooden L-4 tower; Rex's page and the 1932 item say L-4 ground house (14x14); the record's kind 'tower' follows the register, so it is a source disagreement rather than a clear record error. The '15' in the register and firelookout.com is not explained (cab or tower height), so no height_m was recorded. No source describes the site today; the record's access 'unknown' is left as is. Two web searches turned up nothing further on Dog Prairie. The Dog Prairie Mount Bailey location is 'five miles west of Mt. Bailey'; the register coordinates are not checked against that.
